title: Littles On the Move
description: 3:30 PM – 4:30 PM · Join us at this inclusive and welcoming playgroup for children ages 0-3 and their grownups. We have tunnels, a ball pit, instruments, and sensory activities. Únase a nosotros en este grupo de juego inclusivo y acogedor para niños de 0 a 3 años y sus adultos. Habrá túneles, piscina de bolas, instrumentos y actividades sensoriales.

title: The Spark Lab: Thursdays Creativos at Ah Haa
description: 3:30 PM – 5:30 PM · Esta clase está diseñada para introducir a los artistas en el mundo de los medios 2D y 3D. Se utiliza una amplia gama de materiales de arte, como pasteles al óleo, materiales reciclados, pintura acrílica y mucho más. Los estudiantes aprenderán siguiendo al instructor mediante un método paso a paso que les permitirá ver cómo sus proyectos toman forma de principio a fin. Para inscripciones, contáctese con Domi 970.728.4519 Ext: 112 Edades: K-4º grado (5-10 años)   This class is designed to introduce artists to the world of both 2D and 3D media. Using a wide range of art supplies, including recycled materials, oil pastels, acrylic paint, and more. Students will learn by following the teacher's step-by-step method, which allows them to see projects take shape from beginning to end. Ages: K-4th grade (5-10years old)

title: Cancer Support Group
description: 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM · Join us for a supportive and compassionate space at our Cancer Support Group held every 3rd Thursday of the month from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM . This group is designed for individuals currently experiencing cancer and for those who are in remission, offering a safe and welcoming environment for sharing personal stories, experiences, and encouragement. Whether you're navigating your cancer journey or reflecting on the road to recovery, this group provides emotional support and the opportunity to connect with others who understand your unique challenges. Come and find strength in the community, share your experiences, and know you're not alone in your journey.

title: Epic Worlds and Celestial Prophecies: Online Author Talk with Rebecca Roanhorse
description: 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM · Register here to step into a sprawling world of celestial magic, political intrigue, and ancient prophecies with New York Times bestselling author Rebecca Roanhorse as we dive deep into her acclaimed Between Earth and Sky trilogy. Black Sun , Fevered Star , and Mirrored Heavens are inspired by the rich and diverse cultures of the pre-Columbian Americas, reshaping modern speculative fiction with unmissable worldbuilding. Black Sun, the first book in the trilogy, introduces us to the holy city of Tova. The winter solstice is usually a time for celebration and renewal, but this year it coincides with a solar eclipse, a rare celestial event proscribed by the Sun Priest as an unbalancing of the world. Meanwhile, a ship launches from a distant city bound for Tova and set to arrive on the solstice. …

title: Ladies Night In!
description: 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM · Join us at the library for an evening of pampering, snacks, and great company. We'll be screening a surprise classic chick flick while enjoying fresh popcorn, artisan chocolate, hot tea, eye patches, and unique nail polishes by Holo Taco. You'll also have the chance to win prizes from local businesses including Studio G, Aveda Telluride Spa, and Two Skirts. Cozy attire and blankets are encouraged. This event is for adults only. Advance registration is encouraged so we know how many self-care supplies to provide :) Gather your girlfriends or come solo and meet someone new at our library Ladies Night In!
